title: fx.pitchshift_s~
description: `fx.pitchshift_s~` is the signal-control version of `fx.pitchshift~`, shifting an input signal’s pitch by a number of semitones supplied to its second inlet. It supports dry/wet mixing, bypass, crossfade duration, and window-size controls; for example, `@drywet 0.5` mixes the original and effected signals equally.
